name: Employee Advance Disbursement
query:
SELECT
  ea.name                         AS "Reference:Link/Employee Advance:150",
  ea.posting_date                 AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
  ea.employee                     AS "Employee:Link/Employee:120",
  emp.employee_name               AS "Employee Name::180",
  emp.bank_name                   AS "Bank::140",
  emp.bank_ac_no                  AS "Account No.::140",
  ea.advance_amount               AS "Amount:Currency:120",
  ea.currency                     AS "Currency::80",
  CONCAT("Salary Advance - ", ea.name) AS "Narration::220"
FROM `tabEmployee Advance` ea
JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = ea.employee
WHERE
  ea.company = %(company)s
  AND ea.docstatus = 1
  AND ea.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
  AND (
        %(status)s = 'Approved' AND ea.status = 'Unpaid'
      OR
        %(status)s = 'Paid' AND ea.status = 'Paid'
      )
ORDER BY ea.posting_date, ea.name
